{{Quote|This cave here seems to contain an old droid factory from the Clone Wars. For some reason it's been reactivated.|[[Jornel Savas]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:CtCA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Contact the Corsec Agent|Corellia}}</ref>}}
The '''Corellia Droid Factory''' was an automated [[droid factory]] secretly built by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Description==
{{Quote|It turned out that the cave here contains an old, fully automated droid factory. It must have been here since the Clone Wars, possibly built in preparation for a possible invasion of Corellia.|[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Varias]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TtLV" />}}
[[File:Corellia_Droid_Factory_2.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The entrance of the cave.]]
The Corellia Droid Factory was located in a remote and mountainous region of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] known as the [[Bindreg Hills]]. The factory was made of series of corridors and rooms dug in the mountain. The underground facility was accessible though a natural cave. Fully automated, the factory was designed to produce large amounts of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] such as [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s, [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]] and [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]].<ref name="SWG:TtLV" />

==History==
{{Quote|My guess is that it was built covertly. That way droids from here could be used to cause chaos on the ground while the bulk of their forces engaged the planetary defenses from space. However, during the Clone Wars, the droid army decided to bypass Corellia when they invaded the Core Worlds. Instead they struck directly at Coruscant. The invasion never happened so the factory was never activated, that is until now.|Lieutenant Varias, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TtLV" />}}
The Corellia Droid Factory was built by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in preparation for a possible invasion of Corellia. During the war, a Separatist unit successfully infiltrated the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]-aligned planet Corellia and managed to build the factory in total secrecy. The objective of the Confederacy was to produce and deploy large amounts of battle droids to cause chaos on the ground while the bulk of [[Confederacy military/Legends|Separatist forces]] engaged the [[Corellian Defense Force/Legends|planetary defenses]] from space. However, the CIS [[Nexus Route/Legends|bypassed]] Corellia when they invaded the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] and [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|attacked]] directly [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The invasion of Corellia never happened and the factory was never activated.<ref name="SWG:TtLV" />

[[File:Corellia_Droid_Factory_4.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Deactivated battle droids in the factory.]]

The Corellia Droid Factory was forgotten after the defeat of the Confederacy at the end of the Clone Wars.<ref name="SWG:TtLV" /> Two decades later,<ref name="TNEC" /> by the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the facility was finally discovered by the droid [[IG-88A/Legends|IG-88]]. The assassin droid planned to use the factory to build battle droids for his [[Droid Revolution|revolutionary]] [[IG-88's Droid Army|droid army]]. IG-88 thus activated the factory and started the production of battle droids.<ref name="SWG:DtDF" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the [[Corellian Security Force]] discovered the situation after it received reports of hostile Clone Wars-era battle droids active in the Bindreg Hills. A group led by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Varias]], including [[Officer/Legends|Officers]] [[Jornel Savas|Savas]], [[Hirka]], [[Druno Kener|Kener]] and [[Mener]], and several CorSec troopers, was dispatched from [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet]] to investigate. The unit discovered that the factory existed and was fully operational. Although the facility was defended by many hostile battle droids but the Corellian government was reluctant to send reinforcement since it would like to avoid drawing the attention of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The government was afraid that the Imperial forces would use it as a reason to deploy a large number of troops, resulting in the Empire taking a much greater level of control of the planet. The CorSec therefore recruited a number of independent spacers to assist its troops in the factory.<ref name="SWG:TtLV" />

[[File:Corellia_Droid_Factory_3.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Battle droids patrolling the facility.]]
Upon their arrival in the droid factory, [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] Hirka and her squad were ordered to recon the area,<ref name="SWG:LtLCP">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Locate the Lost Corsec Patrol|Corellia}}</ref> Sergeant Mener was tasked to take the fight to the droids,<ref name="SWG:D10BD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Legacy Quest: "Destroy 10 Battle Droids" on Corellia</ref> and [[technical officer]] Kener had to find a way to shut down the facility.<ref name="SWG:FaAtFCT">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Legacy Quest: "Find and Activate the Four Control Terminals" on Corellia</ref> When Sergeant Hirka and her squad were trapped by the droids, Lieutenant Varias dispatched spacers to rescue them.<ref name="SWG:LtLCP" /> Meanwhile, spacers worked with Officer Kener to create a security breach in the factory's control system.<ref name="SWG:FaAtFCT" /> Other spacers were enrolled by Sergeant Mener and destroyed more than two dozens of droids.<ref name="SWG:D10BD" /><ref name="SWG:D10SBD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Legacy Quest: "Destroy 10 Super Battle Droids" on Corellia</ref><ref name="SWG:D5D">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Legacy Quest: "Destroy 5 Droidekas" on Corellia</ref> The spacers also fought an epic battle against a very powerful prototype of an [[EV-series supervisor droid/Legends|EV-series]]-like battle droid.<ref name="SWG:DtPD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Destroy the Prototype Droid|Corellia}}</ref> Eventually, Lieutenant Varias tasked spacers to access the control override terminal in the depths of the facility. The spacer finally reached the terminal in the command center of the facility and effectively shut down the Corellia Droid Factory. According to Varias, the intervention of the spacers permitted to contain the crisis and avoid a disaster.<ref name="SWG:DtDF" />

Following this failure, IG-88 later established a new [[Nym's Factory Compound|droid factory]] on the planet [[Lok/Legends|Lok]] to replace the Corellia Droid Factory.<ref name="SWG:C7">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Chapter 7: A Collection of Heroes</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Corellia Droid Factory was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TtLV" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Corellia Droid Factory was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 12|Game Update 12]]," on [[August 10]], [[2009]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Game Update 12: Engineering Trader">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=976424|text=Game Update 12: Engineering Trader}}</ref>
